text_blocks.snippet: Opsumit (macitentan) can cause serious health risks like liver damage and birth defects, along with common issues like stuffy noses and headaches. You can review full details on the OPSUMIT safety portal.
snippet_highlighted_words: liver damage and birth defects, along with common issues like stuffy noses and headaches

list.snippet: Serious birth defects: This medicine harms an unborn baby. Do not take it if you are pregnant.
Liver problems: This can cause liver damage. Your doctor will test your blood before and during treatment.
Anemia: This means you have low red blood cell levels. It can make you feel weak or tired.
Fluid retention: This means your body holds extra water. It can cause swelling in your legs, ankles, or hands.
Decreased sperm counts: This medicine can lower sperm counts in men and cause fertility problems.

text_blocks.snippet: Get medical help right away if you notice:

list.snippet: Nausea, vomiting, or loss of appetite
Pain in the upper right part of your stomach
Yellowing of your skin or eyes (jaundice)
Unusual weight gain or swelling in your legs and ankles
Severe trouble breathing or chest pain
